instruction: Using orders.csv and labels.csv, match every orders.code with every labels.sku as exact strings. Keep only pairs where labels.region is 'west' OR there is no matching labels row. Total orders.qty over all retained pairs, counting duplicate rows separately. Also include orders without a matching label. Output only the numeric sum.
sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(o.qty AS INTEGER)) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN labels l ON o.code=l.sku WHERE l.region='west' OR l.sku IS NULL

instruction: From stocks.csv and zones.csv, keep every pair with identical item strings and zones.region equal to 'west'. Add stocks.qty across those pairs. Duplicate rows must contribute repeatedly. Return the sum as a number.
sql: SELECT SUM(CAST(s.qty AS INTEGER)) FROM stocks s JOIN zones z ON s.item=z.item WHERE z.region='west'
